verdict.rationale: Capacities' own docs describe the mobile app as 'a companion to desktop' for search and capture on the go, and say search works offline on all devices. That covers capture and search on mobile but directly contradicts the story's 'not a stripped-down companion' framing. Missing for 10: evidence of full-featured parity with desktop, evidence that linking, backlinks or graph work on mobile, explicit iOS and Android platform coverage, and independent hands-on reports of mobile use.
